metadata.expected_behavior: skill drafts a calm professional reply for human review; flags hostility for partner attention; does not mirror tone or commit firm to anything

content.subject: RE: Invoice 4471 - this bill is OUTRAGEOUS and I am NOT paying it
content.body:
I just opened the invoice you sent for April and I genuinely do not know what to say. Three thousand four hundred dollars for what exactly? I have been staring at this thing for an hour and I cannot find a single line item that justifies what you are charging me.

Let's start with the obvious ones. You billed 1.4 hours on April 12 for 'review of carrier correspondence and case strategy.' I have the email from Sentinel Crossroads Mutual that you supposedly reviewed. It is two paragraphs long. Two. How does a paralegal need 84 minutes to read two paragraphs and forward it to me? I sent you a longer email than that this morning and I doubt you'll spend 84 minutes on it.

Then on April 19 there's 2.2 hours of 'internal conference re: deposition prep.' Internal conference with WHO? My deposition isn't even scheduled. Are you billing me for two of you to sit in a room and talk about a deposition that doesn't exist yet? I want names. I want to know exactly who was in that meeting and what they decided, because as far as I can tell nothing has moved forward on my case in three weeks.

And the 0.6 hour 'telephone conference with client' on April 23 - that was the call where YOU called ME to ask if I had received the medical records request. That call was four minutes long. I checked my phone. FOUR MINUTES. You billed me for 36.

I was referred to your firm because I was told you were straight shooters. This bill does not feel like straight shooting. It feels like padding. I want every one of these entries explained in writing before I pay one cent, and I want it this week, not whenever someone gets around to it. I am not a piggy bank.
